reviews.t: Gets areas you can’t normally reach!
reviews.x: I like this device. It really helps reach spots you can’t reach with a wash cloth or without the help of a family member. My back would itch so bad and it was because I wasn’t able to get all the dirt off with the wash cloth. This did the trick. No more wiggling around from a itchy back. 😊

I'm not going to lie, I purchased my back scrubber in June...and I am STILL shocked by the quality of this back scrubber! When I first received it, I wasn't sure what to expect from something that looked so simplistic, although the quality stitching and material of this scrubber was quite different from what I've seen before. The fabric of the scrubber is slightly cushioned, and much like a crushed satin texture. After trying it out in the shower (for over month now), I'm excited to say that its

reviews.t: This really impressed me and made me soft again
reviews.x: Just received this today was waiting to try it and it did not disappoint it impressed me. My back has been so itchy and it was getting little dry patches on it that I could not reach. This worked so well my back is now silky smooth just after one use. I live in Arizona and we get really dry scaly skin, now I will have this to keep me silky smooth all year long. I am going to buy another one for a back up because I like this so much.

Works really well, stays flat and the exfoliating side feels good. I tried to use a wooden back scrubbing brush, but after it got moldy around where the bristles are anchored, I gave up on it. The handles are a nice design; even though the one with the rope loops on the end looks better (in my opinion), I can see where it will be a problem and turn the whole thing into a thick "rope". This one stays flat during use.

My wife always wanted one of these and I never could understand why! Until I tried it myself. I love the fact that it feels like it's cleaning you way better than a rag or cloth etc.... The quality and grip make it so satisfying to use. I love how it bubbles up the more you use it. The natural color matches my bathroom and after I clean it and hang it to dry it actually dries pretty fast. A great buy for those who want to create a nice spa feel to their shower collection.

I had always had difficulty reaching parts of my back, and I decided to buy this a try. You can totally FEEL the difference after using it! It's soft and easy to use. Basically put on some soap or whatever wash you'd like and use it to buff you back clean. I also use it for my legs and arms. And the last but not the least this Scrubber comes in a very nice package.

I love this product, I like that it can reach your entire back, and the loop handles are very handy for the grip , and also to hang while drying.  There are two separate exfoliating sides, one more exfoliating and the other is softer.  I feel very clean after using this every day.

reviews.t: Was 1 star, but customer service made it 5 star.
reviews.x: My first one I bought, the strap snapped on it after 2 uses. The seller reached out and sent out a replacement very quickly. The first one was just defective because the new one has worked out as expected. This item is very useful for people who can't reach all of their back.
My husband wanted something to really scrub his back and well this didn't do the trick for him.

This works very well I had a rash on my back that was always itching, my dermatoligist told me it was a build up of dry dead skin. I got tired of asking my husband to wash and lotion my back.  I have bersitis in my shoulder can't raise my arm very high, I tried other back brushes button they don't bend and still couldn't reach the center of my back, I love this because it's long and flexible.  The side that scrubs feels so good just like a loofa, the other side lotions me.

reviews.t: Easy to use and versatile (scrubby & soft sides)
reviews.x: The only thing that kept it from 5 stars is I expected it to be a little longer - I have to continually readjust to get my whole back, but it's a good scrubber overall.

I was very hopeful based on the reviews it received. One thing no one mentioned is how small it is. It is not very long nor wide enough to get your back. I am 5'2 108 lbs and this is small for me. Go figure!! I threw mine away. Save your money.

reviews.t: A little short and edges like to curl up when wet
reviews.x: I would say the photos and description of the product listing are accurate. What I found a bit disappointing comes when in use. First, to grab the ends behind your back you have to swing it to your other hand (male 5' 10") like a little game. Second, when the absorbent towel and sponge part are wet the lengthwise edges curl towards the textured plastic-like side. The curling makes it more like 2 narrow ropes are scrubbing your back than flat textured area. Some engineering in the sewing departme

If I could give this item a -5 stars I would.  I bought this for myself to use cause it hard for me to get the middle of my back. So I used it on the three day and one of the handle ripped off. So I’m like ok that’s fine I can fix the problem.  Well, a few days go by and it goes great and then all of a sudden, the other one ripped off.  So now I can’t used,  but I’m going to try to sow them back on.  I will say that, I’ll never purchase bath accessories from this company again.

reviews.t: Has a bad smell even after washing
reviews.x: This product has a very bad smell. I put it in a laundry bag put it through the washer and air dried it still has a really bad smell and it even changed color.
not worth buying. Better off having your mom come help get those hard to reaxh places. It broke on my after 2 washes and doesnt strech
Broke on first use ..... I put 2 stars because it scrubs pretty well. I would have put 5 if it didn't break right away.
This is much smaller than it’s shown to be in the picture but it works.
Garbage. Both handles ripped off first use.

It's a decent back scrubber for the price but if you look at the pictures, there seems to be two versions for sale. One has a smooth side and an exfoliating side and the other has an exfoliating side on both sides. Mine has the exfoliating side on both sides. The handle construction on the two seem are different. The one with both the smooth/exfoliating sides appears to be better constructed. I'll keep mine as it seems to work ok - we'll see how it holds up. Seller should indicate that there are

reviews.t: It broke on both ends on the first use, within seconds
reviews.x: I’m not sure why there are so many good reviews, there’s no way this didn’t happen to anyone else!  Nice package, decent texture, started cleaning my back and with maybe 3lbs if pressure the first loop broke open. I rolled my eyes and grabbed the string and kept going. The other side broke off too within minutes.  Sorry, the cheap one will work longer.  I paid the extra few dollars with the assumption it wouldn’t break or be low quality.

I battle moderate back acne and I like the material and it’s exfoliating feeling. Unfortunately the single stitched ‘handles’ began ripping after about 3 weeks of daily use. I made do with what stayed attached but as of tonight both ends have ripped off and now I finished it off by using it to quickly wipe of the soap scum around my standup shower.

My first rating was 1 star based on the fact that the handle broke the third time I used it. The idea is good though.  I would question the quality of this product. I can still use it without one handle.  I changed my rating from 1 star to 4 stars because the company reached out and sent me a new product.

reviews.t: Good texture but too short to use comfortably
reviews.x: The soft and rough side textures are very effective in giving a gentle or more vigorous exfoliation. However the length of the scrubber is too short to use comfortably when scrubbing your back.  Your wrists and elbows have to twist into an uncomfortable position to make it work effectively.

Works really good!! I feel like my back gets really clean, less back acne.The only thing is when you’re using the scrubber. It flips over while you’re cleaning your back. It’s not a major concern though. It gets the job done. I enjoy using this on my back.

claims.text: Many reviewers say it effectively reaches parts of the back they can't reach with a cloth or on their own.
Several reviewers praise the quality, grip, and dual exfoliating sides, with some saying it leaves skin feeling clean and soft.
A few reviewers find it too short or small to comfortably cover the whole back.
Some reviewers report durability problems, including handles or straps ripping or snapping.
A few reviewers mention issues like curling edges when wet or a lingering bad smell after washing.
